alt: 2024 Tesla Cybertruck Foundation Series in front-left three-quarter view at a car show, showing its angular stainless-steel wedge body and hard geometric lines
story: Tesla announced on November 6, 2026 that it will end Cybertruck production in 2027 to free factory space for Cybercab robotaxis, retiring a vehicle that promised 250,000 units/year, delivered roughly 30,000, and racked up 11 safety recalls in three years.
why_funny: A truck unveiled by shattering its own supposedly indestructible windows live on stage, designed with flat steel panels no factory knew how to weld, is being cancelled to make room for robot taxis.
